relationship_to_c61: new prospective replication; not the missing original C61 execution

architecture.teacher: repository Residual-MLP Net(d=64, depth=4) from c10_boundary_signal_ablation.py
architecture.base_recursive_hierarchy: four TinyRes(64,8) locals -> two retrained pairs -> two TinyRes(64,16) compressors -> Chain

distribution_shift.noise_pairing: within each model seed, P4 and P8 use exactly the same shifted calibration and validation tensors

calibration.subset_rule: one protocol-fixed subset of the clean training split; identical across P4/P8 and across model seeds

interface_basis.method: nested QR of shifted-calibration teacher residual transpose
interface_basis.sign_canonicalization: for each Q column, make the largest-absolute entry nonnegative
interface_basis.P8: first 8 columns of the same Q

per_seed_metrics.validation_accuracy: full-span replacement accuracy on shifted validation split
per_seed_metrics.nmse: compiled replacement hidden-state NMSE versus shifted teacher final activation, normalized by shifted-teacher validation variance
per_seed_metrics.frozen_nmse: same metric for compiled frozen hierarchy; informative

eligibility.eligible_if: runner completes, exact recursive parameter-budget invariant holds, and required P4/P8 metrics are finite and positive where required

validation_noninferiority.statistic: paired P4 minus P8 shifted-validation accuracy
validation_noninferiority.pass: paired percentile bootstrap 95% lower bound > -2.0 percentage points

nmse_ratio.statistic: geometric mean of paired P4/P8 NMSE ratios

primary_decision.overall: C61R_CONFIRMATORY_PASS iff eligible_count >= 8 and both primary gates pass; otherwise STOP_INSUFFICIENT_ELIGIBLE or C61R_CONFIRMATORY_FAIL; no rescue analysis changes the confirmatory decision

analysis_boundary.scope: Residual-MLP recursive hierarchy on sklearn digits under this exact additive Gaussian sigma=0.04 implementation; not a universal architecture minimum-interface claim
